name: Pallof Press
common_faults: rotating at the torso when pressing (defeating the purpose)
standing too far from the cable (too hard) or too close (too easy)

substitutions.note: anti-lateral-flexion; dynamic carry vs static press

resistance_profile: hardest at full arm extension; cable torque peaks when arms are straight and cable is perpendicular to torso

provenance.notes: Trains trunk anti-rotation under cable load. Created by physical therapist John Pallof. Often used in rehabilitation and injury-prevention contexts.
